newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean feed millers seek 52,000T of feed wheat. [corrected 04:07 gmt]
newsitem.headline: S.Korean feed millers seek 52,000T of feed wheat. [corrected 04:07 gmt]

text.p: South Korean feed mill companies, including Sunjin Feed Co Ltd and Jeil Feed Mill Co Ltd, have invited tenders on Friday for 52,000 tonnes of feed wheat for delivery on January 10, traders said.
Shipment was slated for November 22 to December 11 if the wheat was from Europe, or December 12-31 if it was from Canada, Australia or the Pacific Northwest, traders said.
Arrival was set for the western port city of Inchon.
